name: Nature Restoration Fund (Helping Nature and Transforming Nature)
summary: Scottish Government competitive grants managed by NatureScot for practical nature restoration in Scotland, with Helping Nature grants from £25,000 and larger Transforming Nature projects above £250,000.

amount.note: Helping Nature grants are £25,000 to £250,000; Transforming Nature grants are above £250,000.

calls.label: 2026-2027 expressions of interest
calls.note: Invited full applications are due Monday 18 January 2027 at 12 noon.

deadline.quote: Expression of Interest deadline: Thursday 26 November 2026 at 12 noon

administered_by.quote: The Nature Restoration Fund includes the competitive fund, managed by NatureScot and direct funding to local authorities through the Edinburgh Process.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are invited from: Constituted organisations Registered charities and trusts Constituted community groups Private individuals and companies - where public benefit will be demonstrated Partnerships and organisations working collaboratively with others.

geography.quote: The Scottish Government has invested over £90 million in projects across Scotland through its groundbreaking Nature Restoration Fund.

access.quote: To submit an EOI, please log into your online NatureScot Grant Management account or register to create a new account.

window.quote: Expression of Interest deadline: Thursday 26 November 2026 at 12 noon

amount.quote: The Nature Restoration Fund has two streams, Helping Nature, for grants of £25,000 to £250,000 and Transforming Nature for grants of £250,000 upwards, including development projects.

co_finance_required.quote: There is a maximum NRF intervention rate of 90% of project costs. This means at least 10% of total project costs must be provided through match or in-kind funding.
